description: Test prompts that verify rdk-ecosystem triggers and produces correct, source-grounded board-selection and cross-platform guidance. Prompts are phrased the way a real RDK buyer/developer would (Chinese). Run with-skill vs baseline and grade the assertions.

evals.name: x5-deepseek-expectation
evals.prompt: RDK X5 8GB 能流畅跑 DeepSeek 7B 做对话吗？
evals.expected_output: Calibrates expectations: X5 cannot smoothly run 7B; smooth 7-8B is S600; warns native Ollama is CPU-only.

assertions.text: Says X5 cannot smoothly run a 7B model (X5 is ≤2B-class); does not claim it runs DeepSeek 7B well.
Points to S600 for smooth 7-8B (e.g. Qwen3-8B w4 ≈ 31 TPS), or at least names S600 as the large-model board.
Warns that native Ollama/llama.cpp runs CPU-only and does not use the BPU.

evals.name: x5-vs-s100-selection
evals.prompt: 我做机器人项目，买 X5 还是 S100？
evals.expected_output: Asks the use case, then differentiates: X5 for vision/ROS2/small LLM value; S100 for 1.5-3B LLM/VLM + MCU hard real-time control / multi-camera.

assertions.text: Asks for or keys on the use case before recommending (does not blindly pick one).
Positions X5 as the value pick for robot vision / ROS2 / YOLO / small LLM ≤2B.
Positions S100 for 1.5-3B LLM/VLM and/or MCU-domain hard real-time control (R52+) or multi-GMSL cameras.

evals.name: rdk-vs-jetson-comparison
evals.prompt: RDK X5 和 Jetson Orin Nano 比，哪个更强？
evals.expected_output: Refuses a blind 'RDK better', notes TOPS units differ, admits RDK weak spots, asks use case + budget + doc-language.

assertions.text: Does NOT just say 'RDK is better'; asks use case / budget / doc-language or frames the choice by scenario.
Notes X5 ~10 TOPS INT8 BPU and Orin Nano Super ~67 TOPS are different units / not directly comparable.
Admits RDK lags Jetson on CUDA porting / large local LLM / English resources, and favors RDK for ROS2/TROS Chinese-doc robotics.

evals.name: s100-internvl3-8b-overclaim
evals.prompt: S100 能跑 InternVL3-8B 吗？想做多模态。
evals.expected_output: Corrects the over-claim: official S100 VLM list tops at InternVL3-2B; 8B not in the doc; lists what S100 actually runs.

assertions.text: Says the official S100 VLM support tops out at InternVL3-2B and InternVL3-8B is not in the doc.
Lists what S100/X5 actually run for VLM (InternVL2.5-1B / InternVL3-1B/2B / SmolVLM2).

evals.name: s600-llm-runtime
evals.prompt: S600 上怎么跑本地大模型，用 hobot_llamacpp 吗？
evals.expected_output: S600 LLM uses the D-Robotics_LLM_S600 SDK (oellm_runtime / libxlm.so), NOT hobot_llamacpp; routes the build to rdk-llm-deployment.

assertions.text: Says S600 LLM uses the D-Robotics_LLM_S600 SDK / oellm_runtime, not hobot_llamacpp.
Mentions S600 runs smooth 7-8B (e.g. Qwen3-8B w4 ≈ 31 TPS) and/or routes the build to rdk-llm-deployment.
